stage.name: Live Report
stage.description:
'Welcome to 'Krysztauowa's Hottest'! As a former guide at the Galería Krysztauowa, please join me and Dossoles TV as we check out the half-price sale at this unusual restaurant, live from the scene!'
<Barricade>Blocks the enemy's line of sight, preventing direct shots.
Combat items cannot be brought into this stage, but can be obtained in the stage.

coalition_army_hound.name: Coalition Army Hound
coalition_army_hound.flavourText: A hound trained by the Bolívar Coalition Army. Perro officers were not too enthused about this being introduced into their tactical considerations.

light_rapid_crossbowman.name: Light Rapid Crossbowman
light_rapid_crossbowman.flavourText: A light crossbowman who can fire three bolts at once. The price of such on-demand firepower is their weakness in long-time battles.
abilities: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 3 bolts in the target's direction

heavy_rapid_crossbowman.name: Heavy Rapid Crossbowman
heavy_rapid_crossbowman.flavourText: A heavy crossbowman who can fire three bolts at once. The Columbian investigation team was forced to admit that these 'homemade gadgets' were just as powerful as some of the latest cutting-edge weaponry.
abilities: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 3 bolts in the target's direction

hound.name: Hound
hound.flavourText: A creature controlled by a Reunion recon squad. Monitoring equipment is strapped to its body. Due to their speed and evasiveness, they can easily slip through enemy defenses and cause heavy damage.

impetuous_grenadier.name: Impetuous Grenadier
impetuous_grenadier.flavourText: A specialized combatant whose fighting methods differ from the norm. The other soldiers call them cannon fodder, unaware that they are seen the exact same way by their superiors.
abilities: Upon taking damage for the first time while unblocked, fires an explosive in each cardinal direction; afterwards, gains increased Movement Speed and reduced Weight

farseer.name: Farseer
farseer.flavourText: An unmanned drone issued by Coalition Army. Though originally designed for reconnaissance, a circuitry issue made it unreliable at this, so an attack module was installed as a last resort.
abilities: Flying unit.
When defeated, Exposes nearby allied units for 8s
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

reckless_grenadier.name: Reckless Grenadier
reckless_grenadier.flavourText: A specialized combatant who does not carry conventional weapons. Though well-paid and exempted from standard military training, nobody envies them.
abilities: Upon taking damage for the first time while unblocked, fires an explosive in each cardinal direction; afterwards, gains increased Movement Speed and reduced Weight

heavy_crossbowman_ambusher.name: Heavy Crossbowman Ambusher
heavy_crossbowman_ambusher.flavourText: A sniper issued with a mass-produced kinetically-boosted crossbow. Though expensive, they are well worth the price tag, capable of stunning targets for long durations after being charged up.
abilities: Invisible
Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 1 bolt in the target's direction that deals Arts damage and inflicts Stun

monster.name: Monster
monster.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone, called 'Monster' by Reunion forces. Equipped with a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Though unlikely to cause heavy damage to armored Operators, they can still pose a considerable threat.
abilities: Flying unit.

farseer_b.name: Farseer B
farseer_b.flavourText: An unmanned drone modified by a Coalition veteran, who haphazardly adjusted the circuitry of the recon module before devoting the rest of his effort into boosting the firepower.
abilities: Flying unit.
When defeated, Exposes nearby allied units for 8s
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

armored_scout.name: Armored Scout
armored_scout.flavourText: An armored scout. The armor they wear is capable of pinpointing the location of attackers.
abilities: Exposes the attacker for 5s when attacked
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

battleline_breacher.name: Battleline Breacher
battleline_breacher.flavourText: Heavily-armored personnel in charge of breaking through enemy lines. They only know how to swing their hammer, whether it's towards a roadblock or a living person.
abilities: Each time this unit is blocked, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased.

heavy_scout.name: Heavy Scout
heavy_scout.flavourText: A heavily-armored scout. The Coalition Army has reinforced the armor, but has no clue how to upgrade the tracing function.
abilities: Exposes the attacker for 5s when attacked
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

mateos_guard.name: Mateo's Guard
mateos_guard.flavourText: Mateo's guard. Certain Coalition Army leaders have cultivated such individuals, leading them to feel that they are above their peers.
abilities: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 2 explosives in the target's direction
When unblocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced

battlefield_observing_mortarman.name: Battlefield Observing Mortarman
battlefield_observing_mortarman.flavourText: A mortarman with keen senses, who fires shells embedded with reconnaissance units. An exceptional talent within the Coalition Army.
abilities: Capable of extremely long ranged-attacks
Shells deal area damage to target and any allied units in the surrounding 8 tiles, and exposes targets for 5s
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

mateos_security_guard.name: Mateo's Security Guard
mateos_security_guard.flavourText: Mateo's security guard. Every Coalition Army leader needs people like these, or they wouldn't be able to sleep well at night.
abilities: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 2 explosives in the target's direction
When unblocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced
